name: power_boost_1s
title: HeyPCB 1S Boost - single lithium cell to 5.1 V, MT3608
brief: 1S to 5 V boost: a JST PH battery input, an MT3608 asynchronous boost with a 22 uH inductor and an SS34 Schottky making 5.1 V, EN pulled up and brought out, 5V / GND / EN / BAT on a 2.54 mm header, a green 5 V LED; 28 x 30 mm, 2 layers.

netClasses.name: PWR
netClasses.why: about 1.6 A from the cell at 3.3 V for 1 A out, and the switch current through the inductor and the SS34: 0.8 mm on a 1 oz outer layer is about 2 A at a 10 C rise (IPC-2221)

rules.why_min_track: Freerouting may neck a power track into a SOT-23-6 pin; JLCPCB 2-layer builds 0.127 mm

board.notes: 2 layers: F.Cu signal + GND pour, B.Cu signal + GND pour, both poured after routing.

bat:J?.why: the cell's lead plugs in from the left edge

out:J?.why: output header along the right edge, pin 1 (5V) at the top; the strip left of it is kept free for its pin labels

boost:U?.why: turned so IN faces the input on the left and SW (pin 1) points down at the inductor

boost:C1?.why: input cap above-left of the converter, clear of the cell connector's body and of its + / - marks

boost:R3?.why: EN pull-up to the input, above the input cap

boost:L?.why: inductor straight below the SW pin: SW pad on the right under pin 1, VIN pad on the left

boost:D?.why: SS34 straight out from the inductor's SW pad, anode left, cathode right

boost:C2?.why: output cap below the diode's cathode

boost:C3?.why: second output cap, at the diode's cathode below the header

boost:R1?.why: feedback divider top, by FB, left of the header's label strip

led:R?.why: 5 V LED along the top edge

switches.why: + beside the pad on VBAT, - beside GND: JST PH cells do not agree on polarity

captions.place_3d: JST PH cell input on the left edge, the MT3608 in the middle with the inductor and SS34 below, the output header on the right edge.
captions.done_3d: MT3608 boost from one lithium cell to 5.1 V, 22 uH inductor, SS34 Schottky, 5V / GND / EN / BAT header.
